lesson.title: Grammar & Function Words — Part 1: Linking Ideas in Conversation
lesson.subtitle: Reasons, contrasts, alternatives and possibilities
lesson.description: Connect two thoughts naturally with because, so, but and choice questions.

learning_objectives: Explain a reason with 因为 (yīnwèi) and a result with 所以 (suǒyǐ).
Ask about alternatives with 还是 (háishi).

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 2 learners with Level 1 foundations

overview.topic_description: Connect two thoughts naturally with because, so, but and choice questions.
overview.focus: Explain a reason with 因为 (yīnwèi) and a result with 所以 (suǒyǐ).

examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù, dàn jīntiān méi shíjiān.
examples.english: I want to go, but I don't have time today.
examples.teaching_note: A short spoken example using 但.

examples.hanzi: 他很忙，但每天都学习汉语。
examples.pinyin: tā hěn máng, dàn měi tiān dōu xuéxí Hànyǔ.
examples.english: He is busy, but he studies Chinese every day.

examples.hanzi: 我喜欢茶，但是不喜欢咖啡。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan chá, dànshì bù xǐhuan kāfēi.
examples.english: I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
examples.teaching_note: A short spoken example using 但是.

examples.hanzi: 今天很冷，但是没有下雨。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān hěn lěng, dànshì méiyǒu xià yǔ.
examples.english: It is cold today, but it isn't raining.
examples.teaching_note: A simple written example using 但是.

examples.pinyin: wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I'll go with you.
examples.teaching_note: A short spoken example using 跟.

examples.pinyin: lǎoshī gēn xuéshēng shuōhuà.
examples.english: The teacher talks with the students.
examples.teaching_note: A simple written example using 跟.

examples.pinyin: nǐ hē chá háishi kāfēi?
examples.english: Do you drink tea or coffee?
examples.teaching_note: In these questions 还是 joins alternatives (conjunction); it may also function as an adverb.

examples.hanzi: 她问：“今天是星期六，还是星期日？”
examples.pinyin: tā wèn: “jīntiān shì xīngqīliù, háishi xīngqīrì?”
examples.english: She asked, “Is today Saturday or Sunday?”
examples.teaching_note: In these questions 还是 joins alternatives (conjunction); it may also function as an adverb.

items.pos_note: In these questions 还是 joins alternatives (conjunction); it may also function as an adverb.

examples.pinyin: wǒ xiànzài jiù qù!
examples.english: I'll go right now!
examples.teaching_note: 就 expresses immediate succession or emphasis depending on context.

examples.pinyin: tā xiàkè jiù huí jiā.
examples.english: He goes home as soon as class ends.
examples.teaching_note: 就 expresses immediate succession or emphasis depending on context.

items.pos_note: 就 expresses immediate succession or emphasis depending on context.

examples.pinyin: tā jīntiān kěnéng bù lái.
examples.english: He might not come today.
examples.teaching_note: 可能 expresses possibility, often functioning as a modal adverb in these examples.

examples.pinyin: míngtiān kěnéng xià yǔ.
examples.english: It might rain tomorrow.
examples.teaching_note: 可能 expresses possibility, often functioning as a modal adverb in these examples.

items.pos_note: 可能 expresses possibility, often functioning as a modal adverb in these examples.

examples.hanzi: 虽然下雨，但我还是想去。
examples.pinyin: suīrán xià yǔ, dàn wǒ háishi xiǎng qù.
examples.english: Although it's raining, I still want to go.
examples.teaching_note: Although  虽然 is usually paired with 但是/但 in beginner models.

examples.hanzi: 虽然他很忙，但是每天都学中文。
examples.pinyin: suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì měi tiān dōu xué Zhōngwén.
examples.english: Although he is busy, he studies Chinese every day.
examples.teaching_note: Although  虽然 is usually paired with 但是/但 in beginner models.

items.pos_note: Although  虽然 is usually paired with 但是/但 in beginner models.

examples.pinyin: wǒ lèi le, suǒyǐ xiǎng xiūxi.
examples.english: I'm tired, so I want to rest.
examples.teaching_note: 所以 introduces the result or consequence.

examples.hanzi: 昨天他生病了，所以没有去上班。
examples.pinyin: zuótiān tā shēngbìng le, suǒyǐ méiyǒu qù shàngbān.
examples.english: He got sick yesterday, so he didn’t go to work.
examples.teaching_note: 所以 introduces the result or consequence.

items.pos_note: 所以 introduces the result or consequence.

examples.hanzi: 因为我生病了，今天不能来。
examples.pinyin: yīnwèi wǒ shēngbìng le, jīntiān bù néng lái.
examples.english: Because I'm ill, I can't come today.
examples.teaching_note: 因为 introduces a reason and may precede 所以.

examples.hanzi: 因为今天下雨，我们在家看电影。
examples.pinyin: yīnwèi jīntiān xià yǔ, wǒmen zài jiā kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: Because it's raining today, we're watching a movie at home.
examples.teaching_note: 因为 introduces a reason and may precede 所以.

items.pos_note: 因为 introduces a reason and may precede 所以.

examples.pinyin: wǒmen zǒu ba.
examples.english: Let's go.
examples.teaching_note: Sentence-final 吧 softens a proposal into a friendly suggestion to go together.

examples.pinyin: “míngtiān zài lái ba.” lǎoshī shuō.
examples.english: "Come back tomorrow," the teacher said.
examples.teaching_note: Written dialogue: 吧 is used naturally in a spoken exchange, rather than forced into formal prose.

examples.pinyin: wǒ bù hē chá.
examples.english: I do not drink tea.
examples.teaching_note: 不 negates a general action or preference; there is no aspect marker for a habitual statement.

examples.pinyin: zhèlǐ bú mài chá.
examples.english: Tea is not sold here.
examples.teaching_note: Practical shopping, food, or everyday-life context using 不.

examples.pinyin: wǒ bú yào zhège.
examples.english: I don't want this one.
examples.teaching_note: 不要 directly rejects an offered object; in some contexts it can sound firm.

examples.pinyin: qǐng búyào zài zhèlǐ chī dōngxi.
examples.english: Please don't eat here.
examples.teaching_note: Short everyday instruction or request using 不要; the tone is polite or neutral.

items.pos_note: Negative request/prohibition: 不 + 要; an expression rather than a single lexical category.

grammar_points.title: A reason and its result
grammar_points.explanation: 因为 (yīnwèi) introduces the reason; 所以 (suǒyǐ) introduces the consequence. One can also appear without the other when the relationship is clear.

grammar_points.title: Concession and contrast
grammar_points.explanation: 虽然 (suīrán) starts a concession and 但是 (dànshì) can introduce a contrasting main clause.

questions.prompt: What is happening in the second part of the reading?
questions.explanation: Use the details in the second paragraph to justify your answer.
questions.answer: Because the weather is bad, Xiao Li goes to the cinema with a friend. Although he likes sports, he also likes movies.

questions.prompt: Write the Mandarin sentence for: I am tired today, so I want to go home earlier. Give both Hanzi and pinyin.
questions.explanation: Use the expressions and grammar you have practised. Suggested answer: 我今天很累，所以想早点儿回家。 (Wǒ jīntiān hěn lèi, suǒyǐ xiǎng zǎo diǎnr huí jiā.)
questions.answer: 我今天很累，所以想早点儿回家。 (Wǒ jīntiān hěn lèi, suǒyǐ xiǎng zǎo diǎnr huí jiā.)

dialogue.title: Linking Ideas in Conversation
dialogue.context_en: Connect two thoughts naturally with because, so, but and choice questions.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今天我们去公园还是去电影院？
turns.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒmen qù gōngyuán háishi qù diànyǐngyuàn?
turns.english: Are we going to the park or to the cinema today?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我想去公园，但是可能会下雨。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù gōngyuán, dànshì kěnéng huì xià yǔ.
turns.english: I want to go to the park, but it might rain.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 因为天气不好，所以我们去看电影吧。
turns.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì bù hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba.
turns.english: Because the weather is bad, let’s go see a movie.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好啊！我跟你一起去，现在就走。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo a! Wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù, xiànzài jiù zǒu.
turns.english: Great! I’ll go with you; let’s leave right now.

reading.title: Linking Ideas in Conversation — short reading

paragraphs.hanzi: 小李本来想在外面运动，但今天下雨了。他觉得可能不能去公园。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ běnlái xiǎng zài wàimiàn yùndòng, dàn jīntiān xià yǔ le. Tā juéde kěnéng bù néng qù gōngyuán.
paragraphs.english: Xiao Li originally wanted to exercise outdoors, but it is raining. He thinks he may not be able to go to the park.

paragraphs.hanzi: 因为天气不好，所以小李跟朋友去了电影院。虽然他喜欢运动，但他也喜欢看电影。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì bù hǎo, suǒyǐ Xiǎo Lǐ gēn péngyou qù le diànyǐngyuàn. Suīrán tā xǐhuan yùndòng, dàn tā yě xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng.
paragraphs.english: Because the weather is bad, Xiao Li goes to the cinema with a friend. Although he likes sports, he also likes movies.

questions.prompt_en: What happens or is explained in the second part of the reading?
questions.answer_en: Because the weather is bad, Xiao Li goes to the cinema with a friend. Although he likes sports, he also likes movies.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: 还是 (háishi) between alternatives commonly marks a choice question; 和 (hé) or 跟 (gēn) usually joins people or things rather than asking which one to choose.
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: Practise the tone change in 但是 (dànshì) and the second-tone first syllable of 还是 (háishi).
